description: Takes the three stereo buses off a bus chain as six separate outputs, and passes the chain on unchanged

inputs.text: Takes the three stereo buses from another module's BUS OUT, and they are what the six output jacks carry

outputs.text: The left channel of the blue stereo bus as it arrives at BUS IN
The right channel of the blue stereo bus as it arrives at BUS IN
The left channel of the orange stereo bus as it arrives at BUS IN
The right channel of the orange stereo bus as it arrives at BUS IN
The left channel of the red stereo bus as it arrives at BUS IN
The right channel of the red stereo bus as it arrives at BUS IN
Carries the three stereo buses exactly as they arrive at BUS IN, six channels on one polyphonic cable, so the chain can go on to the next module

notes: this module does nothing until another Glue the Giant module's BUS OUT is patched into its BUS IN; the six output jacks carry what arrives there
